about: DiligenceOS's own refusal-first conformance corpus. `valid` means no errors; on `decide` sets the answer is a `verdict`. The refusals are the substance. Expected codes are compared only where a case names them, and extra codes are allowed. Generated by conformance/build_diligenceos_1.py: regenerate, never hand-edit. All keys are fixed-seed test keys that protect nothing. Some sets are specific to this implementation's HTTP handlers (decide-api).

protocol.about: One JSON object per line in, one per line out.
